tools.name: audit_website
tools.description: Run the full Fukamo SEO and AI-readability audit on one public URL — the same result the website gives, including Lighthouse, network and rendered checks. A full audit takes a few minutes; if it is not finished within about 45 seconds the tool returns an audit id — then call get_audit_result with it instead of starting again. Returns the score, the counts and the failing checks worst-first with a fix for each. Use it to find what to improve on a page, or to confirm a change fixed something.

url.description: Public URL of the page to audit, including https://

query.description: Optional search phrase the page should rank for. Without it Fukamo uses the first keyword it suggests for the page, as the website does.

tools.name: get_audit_result
tools.description: Wait for an audit started by audit_website or audit_website_pages and return its result. Waits up to about 45 seconds; if the audit is still running it says so and can be called again with the same id. Checking costs nothing; starting a new audit would.

audit_id.description: The audit id a previous Fukamo tool call returned

tools.name: fukamo_report_pdf
tools.description: Save the Fukamo report for one page as a PDF file — the same document the website gives. Pass audit_id to use an audit that already ran (no new audit is charged), or url to run a new one. A full audit takes a few minutes; if it is not finished within about 45 seconds the tool returns an audit id — then call fukamo_report_pdf with it instead of starting again. Use it when someone asks for a report or a document to send on. Reports are limited to 15 an hour by default; on a 429, wait rather than retrying.

url.description: Public URL of the page to audit, including https://

audit_id.description: The audit id a previous Fukamo tool call returned

path.description: Where to write the PDF, e.g. ./report.pdf

query.description: Optional search phrase the page should rank for. Without it Fukamo uses the first keyword it suggests for the page, as the website does.

tools.name: audit_website_pages
tools.description: Run the full Fukamo audit on up to 10 public URLs of the same website. A full audit takes a few minutes; if it is not finished within about 45 seconds the tool returns an audit id — then call get_audit_result with it instead of starting again. Available only when the operator has enabled multi-page audits; if it is refused, audit the pages one at a time with audit_website.

urls.description: 1–10 public URLs of the same website, each including https://

query.description: Optional search phrase the page should rank for. Without it Fukamo uses the first keyword it suggests for the page, as the website does.
